items.claim: Command to be fruitful and multiply

items.quote: a nation and a company of nations shall be of thee
items.claim: A nation and company of nations shall come from thee
items.actor: a nation and a company of nations

items.quote: kings shall come out of thy loins
items.claim: Kings shall descend from thy loins

items.quote: the land which I gave Abraham and Isaac, to thee I will give it
items.claim: The land formerly given to Abraham and Isaac will be given to thee

items.quote: to thy seed after thee will I give the land
items.claim: The land will be given to thy seed after thee
